summary: Iteration 30 - QR Code Canvas, JWT 30-day Expiration, and PWA Login Redesign Testing Complete. All core features verified working correctly. Backend: JWT expiration confirmed at 30 days (720 hours), /me endpoint returns fresh token for silent refresh, invalid member code returns 404 with error message. Frontend: PWA login page has 6 individual code input fields with auto-focus, auto-advance, backspace navigation, paste support (code verified), and auto-submit. QRCodeCanvas renders correctly on member home and fullscreen modal. Countdown timer works for dynamic QR mode.
